messages.en:
{07 14 00}Some accessories{01 00 00 0a 00} can really
transform your whole outfit
into something awesome.
{07 1b 00}Careful though,{01 00 00 05 00} 'cause other
items can turn you into a
walking fashion "don't." Ick!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Mõned aksessuaarid{01 00 00 0a 00} võivad
kogu su rõivastuse
millekski vägevaks muuta.
{07 1b 00}Ettevaatust,{01 00 00 05 00} sest teised
esemed võivad teha sinust
kõndiva moeapsaka. Öök!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}When I was little,{01 00 00 0a 00} clothing
stores were like clubhouses
to me, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 19 00}I loved to crawl and hide in
{01 00 00 0a 00}racks full of clothes!{07 00 00}
{01 00 00 14 00}Hmm...
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 14 00}Now that I think of it,
{07 14 00}I still do it when no one's
looking, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Kui ma väike olin,{01 00 00 0a 00} olid
riide- poed minu jaoks nagu
klubimajad, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 19 00}Mulle meeldis roomata ja
peituda {01 00 00 0a 00}riideid täis
riiulitesse!{07 00 00} {01 00 00 14 00}Hmm...
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 14 00}Kui ma nüüd mõtlen,
{07 14 00}teen ma seda ikka, kui
keegi ei vaata, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Oh, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 14 00}Are you all
about fashion now, too?
{07 00 00}Well, I think it's great!{01 00 00 14 00}
Your look really needed
updating. {07 14 00}And this shop has
some great options.
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Oi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 14 00}Kas sina
oled nüüd ka moe lainel?
{07 00 00}Minu arust on see imeline!{01 00 00 14 00}
Su välimus vajas tõesti
uuendamist. {07 14 00}Ja sel poel on
häid valikuid.

{07 14 00}Uuenduslik, omanäoline,
värske,{01 01 00}{07 00 00} ja ehk isegi natuke
mässumeelne!
{07 0a 00}Jah,{01 00 00 0a 00} sellest mood
{04 03 00} linnas koosnebki.{01 00 00 14 00}
See on {04 01 00} stiil!

messages.en:
{07 04 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Aw, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 1c 00}{01 00 00 14 00}Why do you
insist on looking{01 00 00 0a 00} completely
frumpy all the time?
{07 16 00}It's not like you're ugly
or anything.{01 00 00 0a 00} You just have 
to try a little.
messages.et:
{07 04 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Ohh, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 1c 00}{01 00 00 14 00}Miks sa
pead{01 00 00 0a 00} kogu aeg nii
lohakas välja nägema?
{07 16 00}Pole nii, et sa oleksid
inetu.{01 00 00 0a 00} Sa pead lihtsalt
natuke pingutama.

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Oh!{01 00 00 14 00} You're all dressed up
in your best outfit!{01 01 00} {07 14 00}You're
so lucky, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 19 00}See, all my clothes{01 00 00 05 00} make me
look my absolute best,
which{07 00 00} {07 1b 00}is kind of{01 00 00 05 00} a curse!
'Cause if {01 00 00 05 00}everything is
the best, then nothing is!{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 14 00}
Whoa, {01 00 00 05 00}I am really deep!
